description.short: Cwmcarn Forest is a publicly managed outdoor destination in the South Wales valleys, 10 minutes from M4 Junction 28. Set in a reclaimed mining landscape, it offers purpose-built mountain bike trails for all abilities, walking routes, a scenic 7-mile Forest Drive, a 4-star campsite, and a visitor centre with café. The legendary Twrch red trail and extreme-rated Y Mynydd downhill make it a destination for serious MTB riders as well as families.
